_comment: Project-level Claude Code hooks for this repo. registry-sync-on-skill reminds the agent to register new skills in asset-registry.yml (see AGENTS.md). Disable with REGISTRY_SYNC=0. conversation-focus-* inject the split check and italic closing summary, then guard the summary (skills/conversation-focus/). Disable with CONVERSATION_FOCUS=0. Requires bash on PATH (Git Bash on Windows).
